integrity: The analytic proof supplies global exactness and every equality case; the standalone finite numerical program is diagnostic only. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is restricted to a positive two-link nilpotent shift on real or complex three-dimensional ell_p, 1<p<infinity; no higher-dimensional chain, arbitrary-matrix, or endpoint-exponent statement is claimed. Bibliographic novelty is bounded by available sources.
title: Exact numerical radius of a two-weight nilpotent shift on \(\ell_p^3\)
